errors.text_span: 从数据可见，空间推理任务的训练集数量最多，同义识别任务的训练集数量最少，而角色识别任务的准确率最高，空间推理任务的准确率最低。各任务的训练集数量普遍高于验证集数量，且训练集数量与准确率之间无明显正相关关系。
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly instructs to "avoid inferring, comparing, or drawing conclusions from the data." This entire section makes comparisons across categories (e.g., "spatial reasoning task has the most training data"), generalizes trends ("training set sizes are generally higher than validation set sizes"), and draws a statistical conclusion about correlation ("no obvious positive correlation between training set size and accuracy"), all of which are forbidden interpretations.
